headline: Archipelago remembers each save’s room, and Difficulty fixes Blarg Station spawns
summary: Archipelago v2.1.0 is released with per-save-slot room tracking that refuses a save from another seed (#26). Difficulty v1.2.4 fixes extra enemies crowding out the ship and Clank when landing on Blarg Station (#34). Item Randomizer v1.0.4 is also released, and all three releases use Mod SDK 1.11.0.
highlights: Archipelago’s world package, progression logic and client receive fixes for seed checks, reconnects and location handling (#24). Real-game checks confirmed that a different room’s save awarded no checks (#26).
Difficulty reserves Blarg Station’s object capacity for the level’s own spawns, so the enemy-count setting of 2 adds no copies there (#34).

Mod listings can state AI assistance (#33). The listing bot now rejects a broken newest release instead of silently offering an older one (#32), and releases explicitly trigger index rebuilding (#27).
Issue #25 asks players to test Archipelago and Item Randomizer logic, including whether Drek and several gold bolts can be reached without the Trespasser.
Co-op crossplay, separate co-op saves, reconnects and host takeover remain in draft #22, which is not ready for review or merge.
